thought.text: The Filament login uses Livewire (405 on plain form POST is expected). The API token works. Let me verify the web frontend's login flow end-to-end.

reasoning_content:
Filament login returned 405 - probably requires a Livewire POST, not straightforward form post. That's expected for Filament v3 (Login is Livewire component). Let me use the JSON:API token instead which already returned 200. The token works.

Let me verify the web frontend login flow properly, and check whether the login route works. Actually the frontend 3000 served the login page. Let me test the next-auth credentials/callback? That's more involved. Let me test the frontend sign-in POST via next-auth.

Actually a good functional check: the API bearer token works. The web app renders login page. Let me verify the web app can talk to the API (frontend depends on API). Let me try the login form submission via next-auth credentials endpoint.

Let me look at what login mechanism frontend uses.
